about: Psalm 25:6–12, said during the washing of hands. At Masses for the Dead, and at Masses of the season from Passion Sunday through Maundy Thursday, the Glória Patri is omitted. The psalm itself remains.

s01.narrative: The priest washes his hands while saying the psalm.

s02.translation: I will wash my hands among the innocent, and go about Thy altar, Lord:

s03.translation: That I may hear the voice of praise, and tell all Thy wonders.

s04.translation: Lord, I have loved the beauty of Thy house, and the place of the dwelling of Thy glory.

s05.translation: Destroy not my soul with the wicked, God, nor my life with men of blood:

s06.translation: In whose hands are iniquities: their right hand is filled with gifts.

s07.translation: But I have walked in my innocence: redeem me, and have mercy on me.

s08.translation: My foot hath stood in the straight way: in the assemblies I will bless Thee, Lord.

s09.translation: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit.

s10.translation: As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.
